Three USB ports allow convenient device charging and connectivity throughout your drive.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, ABS brakes, and brake assist technology work together to help maintain control. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering contributes to confident handling and responsive braking.

This Impala is ready to serve you dependably. Stop by our showroom to see it in person and take it for a test drive.

This 2015 Buick LaCrosse Premium I Group offers sophisticated midsize sedan styling with a refined driving experience designed to meet the expectations of discerning drivers.

- White Frost Tricoat exterior paint
- Driver Confidence Package #1 with Side Blind Zone Alert, Lane Change Alert, and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
- Head-Up Display for convenient information viewing
- Forward Collision Alert and Lane Departure Warning System
- Xenon High-Intensity Discharge articulating headlamps with front halogen fog lamps
- 19" chrome aluminum wheels with all-season tires
- Continuously Variable Real Time Damping chassis suspension
- 3.6L V6 flex fuel engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- IntelliLink AM/FM stereo with CD player and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Premium Bose Centerpoint 11-speaker surround sound system
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with leather appointments
- 8-way power front seats with memory function and 4-way lumbar adjustment
- Dual front and side airbags with anti-whiplash head restraints

The engineering foundation of this sedan reflects Buick's commitment to balanced handling and passenger comfort. The HiPer strut front suspension and H-arm rear suspension work in concert with the electronically tuned damping system to deliver a smooth, controlled ride across varying road surfaces. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs impacts effectively while maintaining responsive steering feedback.

Safety technology is integrated throughout the vehicle. The Driver Confidence Package #1 provides multiple layers of awareness, including side blind zone monitoring, rear cross-traffic detection, lane departure warning, and forward collision alerting. The system uses radar-based sensors to track nearby vehicles and road conditions, giving you information to make informed driving decisions. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide additional confidence in various driving situations.

The interior presents a premium atmosphere with perforated leather-appointed seating surfaces throughout the front bucket seats. Heating and ventilation functions allow personalized climate control for both driver and passenger. The power adjustable driver seat includes memory settings that recall preferred positions, while the heated steering wheel adds comfort during cold weather driving. Automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin climate with separate front dual zones.

The 3.6L V6 engine produces power while accommodating both regular and E85 flex fuel options, offering flexibility at the fuel pump. Combined with the 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive configuration, the sedan returns 18 city and 28 highway MPG. This practical efficiency makes the LaCrosse suitable for both daily commuting and extended trips.

This 2015 Honda Civic EX-L sedan combines reliability with practical everyday comfort. The 1.8L four-cylinder engine delivers a balanced driving experience, returning 30 city and 39 highway MPG to help manage fuel costs. Paired with a continuously variable transmission and front-wheel drive, this vehicle handles both commutes and longer drives with consistent performance.

The cabin reflects the EX-L's premium positioning. Reclining heated front bucket seats dressed in leather provide comfort during daily drives, while the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your journey. Automatic temperature control ensures the cabin stays at your preferred setting, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Safety and visibility are prioritized throughout this model. An exterior parking camera rear assists with backing maneuvers, while front fog lights and fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality enhance visibility in varying conditions. The vehicle includes a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS for confident handling in different driving situations.

Technology and convenience features support your daily routine. Remote keyless entry, an illuminated entry system, and a trip computer provide practical functionality. The audio system features six speakers, a CD player, and radio data system capabilities, giving you flexibility in how you enjoy your music and information.

The ride quality benefits from four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering, which adapt to your driving conditions. The 17" alloy wheels contribute to both the vehicle's appearance and handling characteristics, while the split-folding rear seat offers flexibility when you need extra cargo space.

This Civic EX-L represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a fuel-efficient sedan with comfort-oriented features and proven Honda dependability. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and discuss how it fits your transportation needs.

This 2022 Nissan Versa 1.6 S offers dependable transportation with practical design and solid fuel efficiency for daily driving.

- Chrome trunk accent
- Carpeted floor mats
- Splash guards
- Remote keyless entry
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Power windows and door mirrors
- Air conditioning with rear window defroster
- AM/FM audio system with radio data system
- Rear parking sensors
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Auto high-beam headlights
- Split folding rear seat
- Front bucket seats with cloth trim
- 15" steel wheels with full wheel covers

The Versa delivers an efficient driving experience with its 1.6L 4-cylinder engine paired with CVT transmission. You'll appreciate the 32 mpg in city driving and 40 mpg on the highway, making this sedan a smart choice for commuters and those seeking fuel economy without compromise.

Safety features are integrated throughout the vehicle's design. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and a knee airbag work together with a rear side impact airbag and overhead airbag to provide comprehensive protection. The electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist systems enhance your confidence in various driving conditions.

The interior prioritizes comfort and convenience. Power steering and a telescoping tilt steering wheel allow easy adjustment for any driver. Climate control keeps the cabin comfortable year-round, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility. Entertainment comes by way of the AM/FM audio system with steering wheel controls, so you can adjust settings safely without taking your hands off the wheel.

Practical features enhance everyday usability. Rear parking sensors assist with reversing, while the trip computer and outside temperature display provide helpful information at a glance. Automatic headlights reduce the need for manual adjustment, and variably intermittent wipers adapt to changing weather conditions.

The vehicle's exterior combines durability with thoughtful styling. The silver finish pairs well with body-color bumpers and a chrome trunk accent for visual appeal. Splash guards protect against road debris, while the 15" steel wheels with full covers provide a finished appearance.

This 2022 Versa represents solid value for buyers seeking reliable, fuel-efficient transportation. Come see it at our dealership to experience the comfort and practicality firsthand.

The Chrome Bumper Protector offers practical protection against minor impacts. Practical touches like the included SR Floor Mats, Trunk Organizer Tray, first aid kit, emergency road kit, and dual trunk hooks demonstrate thoughtful design for everyday ownership.

This well-equipped Altima represents solid transportation backed by Nissan reliability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover how this sedan meets your driving needs.

This 2012 Toyota Camry LE delivers reliable transportation with proven durability and practical design that serves everyday driving needs effectively.

- 8-way power driver seat with lumbar support
- AM/FM/CD player with 6.1" touch screen
- Remote keyless entry
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Air conditioning
- Power steering and power windows
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Cruise control
- Four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist
- Dual front and side impact airbags plus knee and overhead airbags
- Front bucket seats with split folding rear seat
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature

The Camry LE is built on a foundation of practicality and straightforward engineering. The 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance suitable for both city and highway driving. With an EPA rating of 25 city and 35 highway miles per gallon, this sedan manages fuel consumption responsibly without sacrificing capability.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and convenience. The eight-way power driver seat with lumbar support allows you to find an optimal driving position, while the comprehensive airbag system—including dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead airbags—provides layers of occupant protection. The touch screen radio system with CD player keeps entertainment accessible, and steering wheel audio controls let you manage functions without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety features are integrated throughout the vehicle. Electronic stability control works with traction control to help maintain grip during challenging road conditions. ABS brakes and four-wheel independent suspension support controlled stopping and smooth handling. Low tire pressure warning monitors a critical maintenance indicator, and illuminated entry makes nighttime access convenient and secure.

The exterior presents the Camry in black with body-color bumpers and power door mirrors. Fully automatic headlights activate when needed, and variably intermittent wipers adapt to weather conditions. The front and rear anti-roll bars contribute to composed handling characteristics that Camry drivers have come to expect.

This vehicle represents a straightforward value proposition: dependable Japanese engineering, practical features that address real driving needs, and a track record of longevity. The Camry LE remains a sensible choice for buyers seeking reliable midsize sedan transportation.

A comprehensive security system and panic alarm provide additional peace of mind.

Inside, the Fusion SE offers comfort with cloth front bucket seats and an adjustable telescoping steering wheel that helps you find your ideal driving position. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for passengers or cargo, and the front center armrest with storage keeps essentials within reach. Climate control with rear window defroster ensures comfort throughout the year.

The SYNC system makes staying connected effortless. Voice-activated controls let you manage calls, texts, and music without taking your hands off the wheel. Navigation guidance combined with real-time traffic updates helps you arrive on time, while 911 Assist can connect you to emergency services and the vehicle health report keeps you informed about maintenance needs.
